long_biography.plain_text:
Mechanical engineering and shipping operations gave Evangelos J. Pistiolis the technical base for his maritime career. He worked with dry-bulk vessels, a London container shipbroker and a Greek ship manager before founding Top Ships in 2000. The tanker owner later entered public markets, with Pistiolis remaining president, chief executive and director. His directly owned shares remain distinct from trust and family-affiliated holdings that collectively carry substantial voting power.

Pistiolis is also a director of Central Group, a private investment platform that owns and manages shipping and real-estate interests. Its related companies provide Top Ships with executives, vessel management and chartering services, while the listed company retains its own corporate assets and accounts. Pistiolis's father owned a shipping-management business used during Top Ships' early development, giving him a substantial industry platform; the company he built was nevertheless founder-created rather than inherited. Fleet values, construction programmes, project totals and market capitalization describe corporate scale, not his personal fortune.
